healthy.name: No treatment needed
healthy.advice: Leaf shows no significant disease signal. Keep monitoring weekly, especially after rain.

early_blight.name: Chlorothalonil-based fungicide
early_blight.advice: Remove and destroy affected lower leaves. Improve airflow between plants and avoid overhead watering.

bacterial_spot.name: Treatment guidance - expert validation required
bacterial_spot.active_ingredient: To be selected from a locally registered product label
bacterial_spot.advice: Remove severely affected leaves, improve airflow, avoid overhead watering, and consult the applicable registered treatment label before any chemical application.

late_blight.name: Copper-based fungicide
late_blight.advice: Late blight spreads fast in humid conditions. Isolate affected plants and treat within 24 hours.
